version_identity.change: Use transaction-owner GhidraProject.save; do not forcibly end owner transactions via TransactionInfo IDs.

targets: Two independent APFS clones of existing B PE plus original persistent Ghidra database, not small fixtures; analysis=false, force_new=false
limits: Stock re-mcp-ghidra 3.0.3 has a verified GhidraProject transaction-owner save bug with Ghidra 12.1.4. This local venv is patched; upgrade must preserve or re-evaluate fix.
Ghidra types are queried correctly, but Rust signatures in these two stored functions remain void() placeholders. MCP cannot reconstruct absent debug types automatically.
get_database_info enumerates all symbols for entry point count, measured about 15-17 seconds on the 991681-symbol B database; prefer cached list_databases metadata for routing.
Same-worker backend synchronous tools queue on MainThreadExecutor. Independent database workers can process requests concurrently.
No claim that every upstream tool or all architectures work; selected true tool calls and persistence scenarios are listed.

Native shared proxy/daemon tested with two independent SDK stdio clients and two cached B workers. Same worker remains serial; independent workers can run concurrently. One SDK context teardown race was observed and retained.

shared_proxy_verification.observed_teardown_edge_case: One previous run completed every request but MCP SDK stdout_reader raised anyio.BrokenResourceError on context teardown from late notifications. Preserved in proxy-sdk-teardown-failure.*. Adding final list_databases response after both workers are closed provided a flush barrier; final run passed. Do not suppress tool failures; retain awareness of SDK teardown race.
